events.title: Palm Jebel Ali Fronds A–F villa contracts
events.eventDateBasis: Primary announcement date; target delivery retained separately

claims.text: Nakheel announced construction contracts for 544 villas on Fronds A–F. Contract expenditure is not a property sale price.
Completion of this contract scope is targeted for Q4 2028. Other frond schedules remain separate.
Additional delivered homes can increase both local activity and competing supply. The direction and size of any price effect require transaction evidence.

events.title: The Yard at Palm Jebel Ali announced
events.eventDateBasis: Primary announcement date; target delivery retained separately

claims.text: Dubai Retail announced The Yard, a planned retail, dining, healthcare and lifestyle destination at Palm Jebel Ali.
Opening is planned in 2027. Announced tenants and projected catchment are not operating amenities or a measured resident count.
Amenities may support everyday use and buyer interest if delivered. Accessibility, competition and existing price expectations still matter; no uplift coefficient is inferred.
